name: YJ MGC Evo II
features: Chỉnh bằng tay; nam châm chỉnh bằng tua vít
reviews: Xoay nhanh và ổn định, hợp mọi trình độ
description: The YJ MGC Evo II is YJ's new and improved version of their flagship 3x3. This updated puzzle has hand-adjustable settings and screwdriver-adjustable magnets. Performance-wise, this new addition from YJ has a fast and stable turn that is sure to impress speedcubers of any skill level. Please note: the center caps of this puzzle only fit in two directions.
